summary: With stageAlign: 'center' on a one-column game layout (768px), the board sat centred but the commands row and the rail (a puzzle's Undo/Redo/Restart and its pack card) stayed full-width from the start edge, so the page read as two left edges. The opt-in now gives the commands and the rail the board's measure and centres them with it; the default layout is unchanged.
